beats.text: The USA spends 81.5% of its GDP on consumption. In China, it is 56.7%.
Final consumption expenditure is expenditure on goods and services by resident institutional units for the direct satisfaction of human needs or wants.
India stands at 67.4% of its GDP, leaving room between its shops and its total production.
Pakistan climbs higher to 92.9%, where nearly every dollar earned goes to daily living.
At the quiet end, Qatar rests at 32.4%, the world's lowest of all 174 countries and territories.
How much of your nation's output goes to daily life?
